learning_outcomes.text: Advanced programming skills in high-level programming languages
Development and maintenance of software systems

Applying rules for an organized and efficient work, responsible attitude towards the didactic-scientific field for creative capitalization of one’s own potential, complying to the principles and professional ethics norms.

Utilizing efficient methods and techniques for learning, knowing, research and development of knowledge capitalization capacities, adapting to the requirements of a dynamic society and the communication in Romanian or an international language.
The graduate has the necessary knowledge for using computers, developing software programs and applications, information processing.

The graduate knows multiple programming languages and is able to write applications in compiled, interpreted or dynamic languages with the ability to choose the appropriate programming language for the specific application to be developed.
The graduate has the ability to develop, design and create new applications, systems or products using best practices of the field.
The graduate has the ability to understand and use design patterns for application development.
The graduate has the basic knowledge required to install, configure and maintain a server system on the Internet.
The graduate has the necessary knowledge to process and verify data and information.
The graduate has the ability to observe and obtain information from various sources.

syllabus_topics: WWW history and concepts: The Internet addressing mechanism, name servers, URLs and URIs
HTML – HyperText Markup Language. HTML 5
HTTP – HyperText Transfer Protocol
CSS – Cascading Style Sheets. CSS3. Responsive design. Web fonts and icons. CSS preprocessors.
XML languages. XHTML, XML, XSLT
DOM – Document Object Model. The Javascript language: fundamental concepts, functions, objects, collections, async programming (setTimeout, promises). Javascript browser API.
Javascript libraries: jQuery
Javascript frameworks: Angular ; React
Server-side technologies: PHP. JSON – Javascript Object Notation, AJAX/Fetch API
Server-side technologies: JSP and Java servlets, Springboot. Hibernate. Rest APIs. API documentation (Swagger)
Server-side technologies: ASP .NET Core. MVC projects. Entity framework. REST API projects.
Other web technologies: graphics (WebGL), real-time communication (WebRTC).
Web security: same-origin principle, cross-site scripting, sql injection.
Web security: same-origin principle, cross-site scripting, sql injection.
